report.headline: FOURIER (NCT01764633) met its primary composite endpoint with evolocumab demonstrating a significant reduction in cardiovascular events, consistent with a robust success prediction from the LDL-C causal model.
report.summary: The FOURIER trial randomized 27,564 patients with clinically evident cardiovascular disease and LDL-C ≥70 mg/dL on optimized statin therapy to evolocumab or placebo. The primary endpoint was a composite of cardiovascular death, non-fatal MI, non-fatal stroke, hospitalization for unstable angina, or coronary revascularization, with 1,630 planned events and a median follow-up of 26 months. Amgen's top-line announcement confirmed that evolocumab significantly reduced the risk of cardiovascular events. The LDL-C causal calculator predicted an expected hazard ratio of 0.751 (24.9% relative risk reduction) with 100% power and a minimum detectable effect HR of 0.87, well below the trial's assumed 15% RRR. Genetic evidence from PCSK9 loss-of-function variants supports causality, showing 15-28% lower LDL-C and hazard ratios of 0.32-0.81 for coronary heart disease. Phase 3 trials demonstrated ~60% placebo-adjusted LDL-C reduction with evolocumab. No new safety issues were reported. Confidence is high based on alignment of genetic, biomarker, design, and announcement data, though the full manuscript with exact HR, confidence intervals, and safety details is pending.

mechanism.target_genetics_rationale: Literature genetic evidence before cut-off (pmid:16554528, 2006) shows PCSK9 loss-of-function variants associate with 15-28% lower LDL-C and substantially reduced CHD risk (HR 0.02-0.79). Open Targets genetic association score is 0.949 but all GWAS studies listed are published after cut-off (2020-2024). The pre-cutoff literature facts (f_9ab568f2bb5b4f, f_e2aefaf8f41dd1) provide strong causal evidence for PCSK9 inhibition on coronary disease.

changes.method: placebo-adjusted, phase 3, LAPLACE-2 trial (pmid:24825642), 420 mg monthly dose, mean of weeks 10 and 12; baseline averaged across four subgroups in same trial

mechanism.notes: LDL-C change from LAPLACE-2 (phase 3, same doses as FOURIER, statin background, placebo-adjusted) used because FOURIER on-treatment placebo-adjusted LDL-C measurement not available before cut-off (f_c3aab55baf0f0e is within-arm, not placebo-adjusted). Baseline 2.79 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) averaged from four LAPLACE-2 subgroup baselines for 420 mg monthly dose. FOURIER used both 140 mg Q2W and 420 mg monthly; LAPLACE-2 420 mg monthly shows -63% (f_770fb041c44e48), 140 mg Q2W shows -66% (f_80855c27941ff8). Median follow-up 26 months (2.17 years) from CT.gov. Planned primary events 1630; actual events and HR/CI not reported in pre-cutoff sources (announcement f_e2f53ec9431aa3 states 'significantly reduced' without numbers). SBP change not reported for evolocumab.

issues.issue: Calculator uses only 420 mg monthly dose LDL-C change (-63%) from LAPLACE-2, but FOURIER protocol allowed both 140 mg Q2W and 420 mg monthly. LAPLACE-2 shows -66% for 140 mg Q2W (f_80855c27941ff8). Using a single dose may not represent the trial's actual biomarker effect.
issues.request: Re-evaluate biomarker change input: consider weighted average of both doses used in FOURIER, or justify why 420 mg monthly alone is appropriate. Update changes.pct_change and method description accordingly.

issues.issue: Baseline LDL-C 2.79 mmol/L (108 mg/dL) is described as 'averaged across four subgroups in same trial', but verifier could not confirm 89 mg/dL for 420 mg monthly subgroup (f_bd4fb4a4bf5f73 not_found). The confirmed 89 mg/dL (f_8973af4323ebd2) is for 140 mg Q2W dosing.
issues.request: Verify the four subgroup baselines used for the average. If 89 mg/dL for monthly dosing is not supported, recalculate baseline using only verified subgroup values (123, 126, 94 mg/dL for monthly; 89, 115, 124, 94 mg/dL for Q2W) and update changes.baseline and method.

issues.issue: Hypothesis for robust_success cites RUTHERFORD-2 as 'phase 3' but verified fact f_1cb9b605781a8d shows phase2. RUTHERFORD-2 is a phase 2 trial (pmid:25282519).
issues.request: Correct the hypothesis text: change 'RUTHERFORD-2: ~60% for both doses' to reflect it is a phase 2 trial, or replace with phase 3 data (e.g., LAPLACE-2 both doses, DESCARTES -57% at week 52).

issues.issue: Hypothesis for population cites baseline facts from multiple trials/doses (GAUSS-3, TESLA, GLAGOV, etc.) not all directly relevant to FOURIER entry criteria. FOURIER-specific inclusion thresholds are 70 mg/dL LDL-C or 100 mg/dL non-HDL-C (f_09d7475857a9a7, f_2fe734e55df53c, f_65901401a986d8, f_7ac52e8932a4dd, f_ed1732cd339281).
issues.request: Trim population hypothesis 'for' references to only FOURIER-relevant facts (inclusion thresholds and FOURIER design paper baseline ranges). Remove GAUSS-3, TESLA, GLAGOV, OSLER baselines.
